name: spotter-injury-risk-model
description: AI-14: daily on serverless. Refreshes the spotter_sessions pipeline, then trains the injury-risk model on spotter.gold.gold_injury_risk_scores (heuristic labels; a training-load and form-trend score, not a diagnosis), registers spotter.ml.injury_risk, moves champion only if test PR-AUC is at least the champion's, and overwrites gold_injury_risk_model_scores and gold_risk_feature_importance. Replace <workspace-folder> with the folder holding the risk_model notebook.
